# generality_text_allowlist.txt -- existing findings of the generality rule in living text
# files that are not Go: a name of ours (the inventory in generality_class_test.go), a
# tailnet address, or a home path naming a user (Rule 1; docs/SPEC-CI.md#generality-text).
#
# "everything must be general. Not tied to the specifics of our fleet, or friends,
# just the general concepts behind."
#
# This is DEBT, recorded the day the scan was widened past .go files; it is not a licence.
# Each row is a place to make general: a placeholder, a config lookup, or a generic name in a
# doc example. Recorded captures live in generality_text_fixtures_allowlist.txt, with a reason.
#
# Format: path/to/file:token count   (token is a name, tailnet-address or home-path)
#
# The list only shrinks, checked in both directions with per-key counts:
# - A finding not listed fails the test; a count that rises fails it.
# - A count that falls, or a row with no finding, fails until the row shrinks.
# - NOVA_CI_UPDATE=1 removes such rows and never adds one.
#
# Rows that stay on purpose, for now: internal/records/testdata/refused/namespace_syntax.json and
# receipt_field_not_allowlisted.json each carry a /Users/<name> path inside a content-id
# fixture; changing the path changes the record's id, so the fixture is regenerated as a
# piece, not edited.
#
# ceiling: 444
